controls.title: Protect facilities and equipment
controls.statement: Use physical zones, barriers and environmental protections suited to the highest risk of the information, systems and services at each facility.
controls.risk: Unauthorised entry, theft, damage or environmental failure could expose information and interrupt important services.
controls.scope: Facilities, secure areas, communications rooms, network devices and other equipment supporting in-scope services.
controls.examine: Compare facility risk assessments and zone designs with barriers, entry points, equipment placement and environmental protections.
controls.interview: Ask facility and service owners how the highest resource risk determines protection and how site changes are reviewed.
controls.test: Walk representative perimeters and secure areas and verify that barriers and environmental protections match approved designs.
test_steps: Select representative public boundaries, controlled areas, secure rooms, equipment locations and environmental protections at critical sites.
Walk the perimeter and compare doors, locks, barriers, alarms, surveillance, fire, water, power and temperature controls with approved site designs and risk decisions.
Perform authorised checks of selected barriers and alarm points, including loss of power or communications where safe, and confirm alerts reach the responsible personnel.
Inspect defects and maintenance records and verify temporary weaknesses receive immediate protection, an owner and timely permanent repair.
controls.expected: Facilities and equipment are protected at a level consistent with assessed risk, and gaps or changes are identified and addressed.

mappings.basis: Requires facilities to be secured and access controlled to the highest risk level for entity resources under the Security Zone definitions.
Requires physical access to systems and infrastructure to be restricted and monitored in the source procedure.
Requires physical protection of network devices in the stated circumstances.
Addresses physical perimeter protection for operational environments.

controls.title: Authorise and monitor physical access
controls.statement: Grant physical access only for an approved need, monitor entry to sensitive areas and review access records and privileges.
controls.risk: A person could enter a sensitive area unnoticed and tamper with equipment, disrupt operations or remove information.
controls.scope: Physical credentials, visitors, escorts, access points, monitoring and access logs for controlled facilities.
controls.examine: Review authorised-access lists, approvals, visitor and escort records, physical access logs, monitoring coverage and periodic reviews.
controls.interview: Ask security staff and area owners how access need is approved, anomalous entry is investigated and privileges are removed.
controls.test: Sample credentials and visitors, verify current authorisation, and trace selected access events through monitoring and review.
test_steps: Select current, transferred, departed, temporary and visitor identities and compare facility permissions with sponsorship, clearance, role and expiry.
Use authorised test credentials at permitted and prohibited zones and verify correct entry, denial, anti-passback or escort rules and event recording.
Trace a visitor from identity check and sign-in through badge issue, escort, restricted-area access and sign-out or badge return.
Review unusual and denied events and confirm obsolete credentials are disabled promptly and monitoring cases reach an accountable owner.
controls.expected: Only authorised people enter controlled areas, unescorted access is limited as required and suspicious entry is detected and investigated.

mappings.basis: Requires physical access monitoring, access-log review and coordination with incident response.
Requires logical and physical access controls for assets important to the function where feasible.
Requires physical access privileges to be reviewed.
Addresses physical access controls for sensitive OT areas.
